snippet.title: Wizdom Academy - Official Trailer | Mundo Gamer Showcase 2026 - Edition 01
snippet.description:
Director, your academy awaits.

Wizdom Academy is a magical management simulation where you build, customize, and lead your own school of magic.

Recruit students and teachers, manage resources, and guide your academy to greatness.

🛒 Add it to your Steam wishlist
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2668000/Wizdom_Academy/

🔥 About the Game

🏰 Build Your Magic School
• Design and customize your academy
• Expand and shape your magical institution

🧙 Manage Students and Staff
• Recruit unique characters with distinct personalities
• Guide their growth and development

📊 Resource Management
• Balance mana, resources, and infrastructure
• Make strategic decisions to keep your school thriving

🌍 Living Magical World
• Interact with a vibrant community
• Discover stories and mysteries within your academy

⚖️ Strategic Decision-Making
• Respond to challenges and crises
• Adapt your management style to succeed

✨ Immersive Simulation
• Blend creativity with management systems
• Shape the future of your magical institution

🎮 For Strategy & Simulation Fans
• Ideal for city builder and colony sim players
• Deep systems with accessible gameplay
